projects.name: LeadSutra AI
projects.title: LeadSutra AI
projects.description: AI-powered platform for business lead generation, proposal creation and email workflows, combining lead discovery, AI research, CRM capabilities and automation.

caseStudyDetails.problem: Business lead generation can involve discovering businesses, collecting useful information, enriching contact details, qualifying prospects and organizing them for outreach. Repeating those steps by hand creates avoidable operational work.
caseStudyDetails.idea: LeadSutra’s inspected discovery backend turns a search request into a configurable lead-processing workflow. It can return discovered records through an API or persist processed leads and business profiles.
caseStudyDetails.flowNote: The stages are optional processing steps after discovery. Foursquare is used only when the primary provider raises a provider-level error; an empty successful Google result does not trigger fallback.

flow.title: Search request
flow.detail: FastAPI accepts query and location inputs with options for deduplication, enrichment, extraction, scoring and persistence.

flow.title: Business discovery
flow.detail: Google Places is the primary provider; Foursquare is a fallback for provider-level failures.

flow.title: Normalize and deduplicate
flow.detail: Provider results are normalized as business leads, with optional duplicate removal.

flow.title: Enrich and extract
flow.detail: Optional website enrichment and contact extraction add information when available.

flow.title: Qualify and profile
flow.detail: Optional lead scoring and business-profile extraction prepare structured results.

flow.title: Return or persist
flow.detail: The API returns results, or the persistence path stores leads and profiles.

caseStudyDetails.architectureNote: This describes the LeadSutra discovery backend source inspected for this case study. The portfolio’s listed stack remains visible separately; unverified modules are not assigned implementation details here.

architecture.title: FastAPI routes
architecture.detail: Search, lead listing and lead detail endpoints expose the service to callers.

architecture.title: Discovery service
architecture.detail: Coordinates Google Places and Foursquare providers and handles provider fallback.

architecture.title: Processing services
architecture.detail: Separate services handle scraping, contact extraction, scoring and profile extraction.

architecture.title: Persistence
architecture.detail: MongoDB repositories store leads and profiles; an in-memory async collection is used when MongoDB is unavailable.

engineering.title: Provider failure handling
engineering.detail: Fallback is tied to provider-level errors, while successful empty results remain valid responses.

engineering.title: Composable processing
engineering.detail: Deduplication, enrichment, extraction, scoring and persistence are controlled as separate workflow options.

engineering.title: Non-destructive extraction
engineering.detail: Extracted contact data fills gaps without replacing an existing provider-supplied phone value.

projects.title: SentinelAI
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Malware Detection Platform
projects.description: AI-powered malware detection platform for Windows PE files using machine learning, with authentication, file upload, scan history, admin dashboard and prediction analytics.

caseStudyDetails.problem: Windows PE files need to be examined before a useful malware-risk prediction can be presented. A product flow also needs to connect scans with authenticated access and a reviewable history.
caseStudyDetails.idea: SentinelAI is described as a machine-learning malware detection platform that accepts PE files and presents predictions alongside scan history and analytics.

projects.name: Emergency Navigation System
projects.title: Emergency Navigation System
projects.description: Django application using the A* algorithm and machine learning for real-time traffic-based route optimization with interactive maps.

caseStudyDetails.problem: Emergency navigation needs to identify a route between locations while accounting for changing traffic conditions, then make the result understandable on a map.
caseStudyDetails.idea: The project is described as a Django application combining A* routing, machine learning, real-time traffic-based route optimization and interactive maps.
